findings.title: Assert the feature-disabled exit code
findings.body: This test checks only the error text, not the exit status. Exit code 4 is part of the newly documented scripting contract for a disabled feature, so the test would not catch a regression that prints this message but returns a different status. Assert that the command exits with `CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED`.
